findings.title: Residual bare-Zen comments after Zen-to-PAL migration (found by corroborating audit)
findings.body: Corroborating audit (opencode + xai/grok-4.5, supervisor-approved fallback per operator instruction 2026-07-31) found 10 comment lines in 9 *-dopemux.md files still referencing Zen. Fixed in commit 50e39279a1; final gate with extended pattern (incl. \bZen\b) shows 0 stale hits outside archive.

findings.title: Formal Tier-1 embedded audit routes exhausted; CI lane is the remaining authority
findings.body: Route #1 AGY rejected (model selection unproven: responded 'Gemini 3.1 Pro' to --model sonnet and ignored the audit prompt). Routes #2/#3 Claude Code CLI sonnet/opus unavailable (weekly usage limit, resets 4pm America/Vancouver on a future day; re-probed after local 4pm PDT, still limited). Route #4 Gemini CLI 0.46.0 failed (exit 1; session-hook memory output pollution; no audit produced). Tier-2 PAL clink NOT_RUN (requires host-side execution outside this sandbox). Tier-3 Copilot not allowed by packet. The independent CI lane (.github/workflows/embedded-audit.yml) must emit the authoritative proof at the PR head; local signed-attestation path (config/audit/embedded-audit-allowed-signers) is available to the operator.

findings.title: Corroborating audits performed are not the formal embedded audit
findings.body: Two independent reviews ran against diff main...HEAD: (1) Command Code subagent codereview -> PASS_WITH_RISKS, HIGH finding (Zen MCP refs) fixed in 67b7af2e5f; (2) opencode + xai/grok-4.5 supervisor-approved fallback audit -> PASS_WITH_RISKS, checks 1-7 all PASS (allowlist scope, archive-only, aliased stems intact, packaged mirrors canonical, no secrets, authority hygiene, fail-closed sync), MEDIUM finding F001 fixed in 50e39279a1. Neither satisfies AGENTS.md 9.1 Tier-1 embedded-audit requirements; recorded as corroborating evidence in review_bundle/auditor_raw_output.txt.

findings.title: tools-field semantics conflict between doc and observed runtime (personal lane)
findings.body: Command Code docs state omitted tools = no tools; observed behavior shows ~/.commandcode/agents agents dispatching and using tools without a tools field. Conflict unresolved (UNKNOWN); no restrictive tools lists were added to working agents without runtime evidence.
